samples.title: Lớp học trực tuyến
samples.prompt: The proposal is that universities should offer online classes alongside classroom lessons. Do the advantages of this proposal outweigh its disadvantages?
requirementsVi: Chọn bên có sức nặng hơn.
Thừa nhận và phân tích bất lợi.
So sánh mức độ tác động, không chỉ đếm số ý.
samples.summaryVi: Học online giúp linh hoạt giờ học; cần thảo luận và hỗ trợ để tránh học một mình.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: The proposal that universities should offer online classes alongside classroom lessons has both positive and negative aspects. In my view, the advantages can outweigh the disadvantages if basic practical support is included. The main benefit addresses a recurring everyday need, while at least some of the difficulties can be reduced through careful organisation.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu đánh giá và điều kiện rõ ràng.

paragraphs.label: Thừa nhận bất lợi
paragraphs.text: A difficulty that should not be ignored is that some learners may feel isolated. This matters because a screen does not always make it easy to ask a quick question or form friendships. For instance, a first-year student may stop working on a difficult task instead of asking a classmate for help. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.
paragraphs.noteVi: Không bỏ qua phía yếu hơn.

paragraphs.label: Lợi ích lớn hơn
paragraphs.text: One important point in favour of the proposal is that students can fit learning around work and family responsibilities. This is possible because recorded lessons can be watched again at a convenient time. For example, a student who works in a restaurant can review a morning lecture after the evening shift. The value of this example is that the benefit is connected with a real everyday need. It is easier for people to see the purpose of an approach when they can relate it to their own situation.
paragraphs.noteVi: Học online giúp linh hoạt giờ học; cần thảo luận và hỗ trợ để tránh học một mình.

paragraphs.label: So sánh sức nặng
paragraphs.text: I give greater weight to the benefit because it could help people repeatedly, not just on one special occasion. The disadvantage is still important, but it is not always unavoidable. One response would be to schedule small weekly discussion groups. A teacher could meet six students at a time and ask each person to explain one difficult point. This gives a concrete reason to believe that the obstacle can be reduced rather than merely ignored.
paragraphs.noteVi: So sánh tính lặp lại của lợi ích và khả năng giảm bất lợi.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, I believe the advantages are greater when the approach is organised responsibly. If the practical support is absent, the balance could change. The strongest case is therefore for a workable version of the proposal, not for assuming that any version will automatically succeed.
paragraphs.noteVi: Chốt nhất quán, không khẳng định luôn đúng.

paragraphs.noteVi: Tư vấn học nghề mở thêm lựa chọn; cần hiểu nội dung học và điều kiện làm việc trước khi chọn.

paragraphs.label: So sánh sức nặng
paragraphs.text: I give greater weight to the benefit because it could help people repeatedly, not just on one special occasion. The disadvantage is still important, but it is not always unavoidable. One response would be to provide course visits and balanced guidance about work and further study. Schools could invite former students from several training routes to discuss both the benefits and difficulties. This gives a concrete reason to believe that the obstacle can be reduced rather than merely ignored.
paragraphs.noteVi: So sánh tính lặp lại của lợi ích và khả năng giảm bất lợi.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, I believe the advantages are greater when the approach is organised responsibly. If the practical support is absent, the balance could change. The strongest case is therefore for a workable version of the proposal, not for assuming that any version will automatically succeed.
paragraphs.noteVi: Chốt nhất quán, không khẳng định luôn đúng.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: The proposal that communities should provide more affordable classes for adults has both positive and negative aspects. In my view, the advantages can outweigh the disadvantages if basic practical support is included. The main benefit addresses a recurring everyday need, while at least some of the difficulties can be reduced through careful organisation.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu đánh giá và điều kiện rõ ràng.

paragraphs.label: Thừa nhận bất lợi
paragraphs.text: A difficulty that should not be ignored is that people with the greatest need may still be unable to attend. This matters because transport, childcare and changing work hours can create barriers. For instance, a parent may miss an evening class because there is no one available to look after a child. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.
paragraphs.noteVi: Không bỏ qua phía yếu hơn.

paragraphs.label: Lợi ích lớn hơn
paragraphs.text: One important point in favour of the proposal is that adults can update skills without returning to full-time study. This is possible because short local courses can fit around work and caring responsibilities. For example, a shop assistant can attend an evening computer class to learn how to manage simple spreadsheets. The value of this example is that the benefit is connected with a real everyday need. It is easier for people to see the purpose of an approach when they can relate it to their own situation.

paragraphs.label: So sánh sức nặng
paragraphs.text: I give greater weight to the benefit because it could help people repeatedly, not just on one special occasion. The disadvantage is still important, but it is not always unavoidable. This gives a concrete reason to believe that the obstacle can be reduced rather than merely ignored.

The strongest case is therefore for a workable version of the proposal, not for assuming that any version will automatically succeed.
